name: Zoho Zeptomail
description: Zoho Zeptomail is a reliable and secure email delivery service designed for transactional emails. It ensures that your critical emails reach the inbox of your recipients promptly and efficiently, making it ideal for businesses that require high deliverability and detailed analytics for their email communications.

events.d: Retrieve email templates for a selected ZeptoMail mail agent.
Add email addresses or domains to the suppression list to prevent emails from being sent to them.
Retrieve suppressed email addresses or domains for a specified suppression type (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), with optional mail agent, date range, and pagination filters.
Remove specified entries (for example, email addresses) from a ZeptoMail suppression list.
Retrieve email delivery logs, or a specific email by reference, with optional filters and pagination. If no filters are applied, all logs are returned.
Delete an email template by agent alias and template key.

events.n: Update Email Template for Selected Agent
events.d: Edit an existing email template for the selected agent, changing its name, subject, HTML or text body, and template alias.

events.n: When a suppression entry (email or domain) is created or updated
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a suppression entry for an email or domain is created or updated in the suppression list.

events.n: When a new email activity is recorded
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new email activity is recorded in the account.

events.n: When a new email log entry is created that matches the configured filters
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new email log entry that matches the configured filters is created in the account.
